title: Minecraft Slime Farm 1.21 - NO SLIME CHUNKS - SIMPLE EASY!
description:
TheySix is here With a New Minecraft Tutorial, In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make a Simple Efficient Portal Based Slime Farm In Minecraft 1.21

📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +3100 Slime Balls Per Hour! 
📚Building this farm depends on the server settings and if you are playing on a papermc server just build the collection system under the roof
📚This farm works in swamp lakes
📚You can build this farm only on the Java edition!
📚Also, to build this farm you don't need to find slime chunks.

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
